items.role: Chair of the Board of Governors
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital (Fiscal Accountability Disclosure); Source link: NYGH Fiscal Accountability
items.verbatim_snippet: Bert Clark completed his multi-year tenure as the Chair of the Board of Governors, stepping down after steering the hospital through the height of the COVID-19 pandemic and positioning the institution for its next phase of major capital expansion and strategic modernization.

items.role: Chair of the North York General Hospital Board of Governors
items.citation_text: North York General Hospital News; Source link: NYGH Newsroom - Mitch Frazer Appointment
items.verbatim_snippet: Mitch Frazer officially assumed office as the new Chair of the North York General Hospital Board of Governors, succeeding Bert Clark to lead the oversight of governance during a critical decade of campus transformation and redevelopment.

items.citation_text: North York General Hospital News; Source link: NYGH Newsroom - CEO Transition Announcement
items.verbatim_snippet: Karyn Popovich retired from her role as President and Chief Executive Officer following a distinguished career spanning over 40 years at NYGH, having successfully navigated the hospital through the operational strains of the pandemic and maintained its top-ranking academic community status.

items.citation_text: North York General Hospital News; Source link: NYGH Newsroom - Dr. Everton Gooden Appointment
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. Everton Gooden officially began his tenure as President and CEO of North York General Hospital following an extensive executive search process, bringing over two decades of clinical, administrative, and leadership experience within the organization.

items.citation_text: North York General Hospital News; Source link: NYGH Newsroom - 2022 New Governors
items.verbatim_snippet: Robert Sankey, Dr. Christine Williams, Toni Rossi, and community member Divya Khan were elected to the Board of Governors at the Annual General Meeting, while outgoing governors Dr. Louise Lemieux-Charles and Sheila Jarvis concluded their terms of service.
